Scene Companion replay scorecard
After merging current main (c4bc21d, Brian's proximity + /phone + FoV)
into this branch. Navigator = baseline (color stub). Scenes are synthetic,
AI-generated photos of one room.

Columns are exact-match vs structured ground truth. prox is Brian's
heartbeat. Depth ONNX is not on this VM (Depth: MISSING), so every
proximity reading is state=unknown and scores 0 — not skipped: silence
must never mean "clear".
